member.summary: Gets the server selection timeout in milliseconds.

member.name: P:Company.Persistence.Mongo.Configuration.MongoSettings.SocketTimeoutMs

member.name: P:Company.Persistence.Mongo.Configuration.MongoSettings.MaxConnectionPoolSize
member.summary: Gets the maximum connection pool size.

remarks.para: Default: 100 connections
Rationale: Sufficient for most workloads. Atlas M10+ supports up to 1500.

member.name: P:Company.Persistence.Mongo.Configuration.MongoSettings.MinConnectionPoolSize
member.summary: Gets the minimum connection pool size.

remarks.para: Default: 5 connections (kept warm)
Rationale: Prevents cold start latency on first requests.

member.name: P:Company.Persistence.Mongo.Configuration.MongoSettings.ReadPreference
member.summary: Gets the read preference for query routing.

remarks.para: Default: "secondaryPreferred"
Options: "primary", "primaryPreferred", "secondary", "secondaryPreferred", "nearest"
Cost Impact: Reading from secondaries reduces primary load by ~40-60%, potentially allowing a smaller (cheaper) Atlas tier.
Trade-off: Secondary reads may be milliseconds behind primary (eventual consistency). Use "primary" for operations requiring strong consistency.

member.name: P:Company.Persistence.Mongo.Configuration.MongoSettings.WriteConcern
member.summary: Gets the write concern for durability guarantees.

remarks.para: Default: "majority"
Options: "0" (unacknowledged), "1" (primary only), "majority" (replicated)
Rationale: "majority" ensures writes survive primary failover and is required for transactions.
Trade-off: ~10-20ms additional latency vs "1", but guaranteed durability.

member.name: P:Company.Persistence.Mongo.Configuration.MongoSettings.ReadConcern
member.summary: Gets the read concern for consistency guarantees.

remarks.para: Default: "majority"
Options: "local", "majority", "linearizable"
Rationale: "majority" only reads committed data, avoiding dirty reads.

member.name: P:Company.Persistence.Mongo.Configuration.MongoSettings.RetryWrites
member.summary: Gets whether to automatically retry writes on transient failures.

remarks.para: Default: true
Rationale: Handles network blips automatically without application code changes.

member.name: P:Company.Persistence.Mongo.Configuration.MongoSettings.RetryReads
member.summary: Gets whether to automatically retry reads on transient failures.

remarks.para: Default: true
Rationale: Same as RetryWrites for read operations.
